question: Is there a discount code or a good deal on the Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 charger right now?
query: Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 charger discount code deal price October 2026

rec.answer:
**I couldn’t verify a working discount code for the Nomos 5-in-1 right now.** There are some advertised sale prices, but the cheapest ones need caution:

- **$52.79 at baseuspower.com**, advertised against $87.99—about **40% off**. The site also advertises free shipping over $50. However, this is not the official **baseus.com** domain, and I couldn’t verify its affiliation or reliability from these results. citeturn9
- **$44.99 at baseustore.com**, but this is another domain whose legitimacy I couldn’t verify. I wouldn’t recommend it based on price alone. citeturn19
- **Official-store price reference: $149.99**, according to a price tracker checked October 21, 2026—not a particularly attractive deal. Baseus has a Halloween sale page, but the results don’t show a Nomos-specific discount there. citeturn14turn16

**What counts as a good deal?** This exact 140W/Qi2 model previously hit **$50 on Amazon**, though that February offer is expired. So **around $50–$60 from a reputable seller would be a strong buy**. citeturn15

My recommendation: check the [Best Buy listing](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-desktop-charger-3c-u-140w-us-qi2-wireless-charging-retractable-cable-digital-display-black-black/J3GWGXKJSC), which identifies the seller as **Baseus Technology US Inc.**, and compare its checkout price. The search results don’t expose its current price; the **$44.99 shown elsewhere in the Best Buy snippet is a different 67W model**, not this charger. citeturn12turn13
